The **Gatling Laser** is a ranged weapon in *Fallout 76*.

A rapid firing automatic heavy weapon that uses Fusion Cores as ammo and it has a clip size of 500. Reload is slow and the gun must "spin up" before it starts firing.

While the reload animation looks like it ejects a core and inserts another, this does not occur. Reloading can be done frequently without losing any ammo. All cores always stay in inventory. Reload adds the number of shots based on the core in inventory with the highest percentage.
